reason: On Linux x86_64 with installed uv 0.13.5 and Python 3.12.3, a dependency-free project containing [tool.uv] preview = true accepted `uv sync --offline --python /usr/bin/python3` with exit 0 and no configuration warning. Adding asdf = true reproduced the warning listing both preview and preview-features as accepted fields. This acceptance is intentional: --show-settings showed identical enabled preview flags for preview = true and preview-features = true, while preview = false produced no enabled flags. The claim that the setting has no effect remains unverified because the report does not identify the affected feature. Windows and uv 0.13.1 were not tested. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md with commands, observations, existing test coverage, and limitations.
